Usage
Rules that keep the chart honest and readable.
2–6 columns × 2–5 categories; group the tail into “Other”.
Same category order in every column, largest at the bottom.
Sort columns by width (share), largest left.
Never put text straight on a categorical fill — use the chip (surface/card).
Why chips
No single text token passes 4.5:1 on every categorical colour in both Light and Dark. A surface/card chip with text/primary always does (12.9 / 15.9).
Spec
Library-neutral contract — maps to Recharts, ECharts, D3, Visx, SwiftUI Charts or Compose.
